verdict.rationale: Pylon documents an omnichannel issue inbox covering Slack Connect, email, Microsoft Teams, the chat widget and forms, plus in-app chat through mobile SDKs. Its Support Agent can be assigned to issues, but the evidence never explicitly ties that one agent to every channel, and WhatsApp and social channels are not mentioned anywhere. Missing for 10: WhatsApp support, social-media channel support, explicit documentation that a single AI agent answers across all channels, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a support leader, one agent covers chat, email, and in-app, plus the channels my customers actually use — Slack, WhatsApp, social

citations.quote: Track customer issues across any channel (Slack Connect, Email, Microsoft Teams, Chat Widget, Forms, ...) and orchestrate agents to investigate and act on your customer issues.
Pylon's mobile SDKs allow you to embed the chat widget directly in your mobile app, providing users with in-app support without leaving your application.
Connect your email addresses with Pylon to track and response to support requests over email.
Pylon watches for customer issues in connected customer Slack channels and automatically bundles together relevant messages and creates tracked issues within Pylon.
You can also assign an individual issue to your AI agent, the same way you might normally assign an issue to a team member.
